source: Each provider's own public website, fetched and read directly (company name, coverage cities, phone number, and app-store links copied verbatim from that site).
coverageNote: Murska Sobota — this app's home city — has no coverage from any taxi-hailing platform found, real (Uber, the six national platforms named by the operator) or otherwise. The closest real coverage is these Ljubljana-area providers, useful only if you are travelling to one of the cities listed.
apiNote: None of these publish a public live-vehicle-position API. Where a provider advertises live tracking, it is confirmed to exist only inside its own native app (see each entry's note) — never on the public website, and never reachable without placing a real order in that app.

providers.name: TaxiMetro
providers.note: Public website is a plain WordPress marketing/contact site — no booking API, no WebSocket, nothing beyond a contact form.

providers.name: City Taxi (Laguna Taxi)
providers.note: The iOS listing is literally titled "Laguna Taxi" under the same App Store id as "City Taxi" — same app, two brand names. Its homepage says "Track your vehicle on the app", confirming live tracking exists but only inside the native app, never on the public website.

providers.name: Taxi Rondo
providers.note: Built by Netinformatika, the same developer as City Taxi/Laguna's app (com.netinformatika.*) — likely shares backend infrastructure between the two otherwise-separate taxi companies. Website itself is WordPress + a contact form, no live data.

providers.name: Yalla Taxi
providers.websiteUnreachableNote: Could not be fetched during this check (proxy-level connection failure, not confirmed to be the site's own fault) — listed here from its Google Play / App Store presence only, not from reading its website content.
